title: Still Life

services.name: Pottery Classes
services.desc: At the Still life ceramics studio, our aim is both to facilitate learning and exploration into the technical skills of handbuilding, while also creating a relaxed and fun space that maybe feels like a break from the outside hustle. We can’t wait for you to come hang out with us, make some cool ceramics, make some new friends, and learn something new! We are so excited to offer the below selection of Summer ceramics courses at Still life! Each course meets weekly in our ceramics studio and is taught by our amazing ceramics teachers and artists! Our one-time ceramic workshops are designed to be a casual creative experience and an oppurtunity to learn some beginning handbuilding

services.name: Course Description
services.desc: Have you been looking to try your hand at ceramics? We would love to have you for our Beginner Handbuilding course at Still life! In this six week course, Anjuli’s tutorials cover the basics of handbuilding including pinching, coils, slabs, glazing and more. She will also provide guidance as you explore these
